digest.component_or_area: reconciler / Jira sync - deletion handling and binding state
propositions: the (inbound, probe) dispatch chain has no live producer because run_differs passes a fetched Jira snapshot lacking jira_key fields, making the producer loop never emit
a local ticket whose binding was retired on a confirmed 404 must not be re-created in Jira, per operator ruling that deleted issues should not be resurrected

the dead chain (differ._compute_mutations_emit_absent_partner_probes, _run_differs_inbound_probe_dispatch, route_inbound_probe, inbound_probe.py) is removed and the resurrection implementation (_apply_inbound_delete, create_after_hard_delete) is deleted rather than orphaned
BindingStore.unretire(jira_key) reverses retirement by dropping the key from both in-memory set and bindings-retired.json, making the local ticket creatable again on the next pass
a suppression guard prevents outbound create for retired pairings while allowing never-bound local tickets to create normally, with observable alert naming the jira_key and unretire as remedy
